In this notebook, I will compile values the Th1, Th17, and Tfh features

# Setup

```{r setup}
library(Seurat)
library(scales)
library(tidyverse)

thisseed <- 231103

colFGID <- "#1E88E5"
coliCD <- "#55D276"
colcCD <- "#FFC107"
colUC <- "#D81B60"
colIBD <- "#EB6D33"
diagSubColVec <- c("FGID"=colFGID, "iCD" = coliCD, "cCD"=colcCD, "UC"=colUC)


colNM <- "#6b6a6a"
colNOA <- "#bfbfbf"
colFR <- "#11d6cc"
colPR <- "#ff8c00"
colNR <- "#ff1e00"
atnfColVec <- c("NM"=colNM, "NOA"=colNOA,"FR"=colFR,"PR"=colPR,"NR"=colNR)

source("../functions/ComparisonPlottingFxns.R")

`%notin%` <- Negate(`%in%`)

timepointShapeVec <- c("T0" = 21, "R" = 23, "R2" = 22)

logInf <- function(x){ifelse(x == 0, log(1/1000), log(x))}
```

# Read Data

## Seurat Object

```{r}
seuobj <- readRDS("data/objects/annotated/predictCOL__CB_allcells_annotated_251017_v4.rds")
seuobj
```

## IL-17 Gene Sets

```{r}
il17.list <- lapply(list.files("data/decoupler/il17/wsum_kegg", full.names = T), 
                    function(thispath) read_csv(thispath, show_col_types = F))

il17.df <- plyr::ldply(il17.list)

il17.df
```

```{r}
il17.names <- c("Antimicrobial", "Chemokine", "Cytokine", "Remodeling")

il17.names
```

```{r}
seuobj <- AddMetaData(
  seuobj,
  il17.df %>% 
    rename_with(~il17.names[.x], .cols = starts_with("il17af")) %>% 
    column_to_rownames("barcode")
)
seuobj@meta.data
```

```{r}
tnfjak.paths <- list.files("out/decoupler/progeny/mlm_tnfjak", full.names = T)
tnfjak.paths

tnfjak.paths <- tnfjak.paths[str_detect(tnfjak.paths, "estimate.csv")]
tnfjak.paths
```


```{r}
tnfjak.list <- lapply(tnfjak.paths, function(thispath) read_csv(thispath, show_col_types = F))

tnfjak.df <- plyr::ldply(tnfjak.list)

tnfjak.df
```

```{r}
seuobj@meta.data
```

## TCRs

```{r}
tcrs <- read_csv("data/tcr/filtered_contigs_paired_241120.csv")
tcrs
```

```{r}
seuobj <- AddMetaData(seuobj,
            tcrs %>% select(-data_folder) %>% mutate(cdr3.Paired = paste(cdr3.TRA, cdr3.TRB, sep = "_")) %>% column_to_rownames("barcode"))
seuobj@meta.data %>% filter(celltype == "TNKILC")
```

## mTiRP

```{r}
tirp <- read_csv("out/tcr/tirp/241120_predictCOL_tirp.csv")
tirp
```

```{r}
seuobj <- AddMetaData(seuobj,
                      seuobj@meta.data %>% 
                        rownames_to_column("barcode") %>% 
                        left_join(
                          .,
                          tirp %>% distinct(cdr3, .keep_all = T), 
                          by = c("cdr3.TRB" = "cdr3")
                        ) %>% 
                        column_to_rownames("barcode") %>% 
                        filter(celltype == "TNKILC") %>% 
                        select(setdiff(colnames(tirp), "cdr3"))
            
)
seuobj@meta.data %>% filter(celltype == "TNKILC")
```

# Calculate Features

## Cellstate Frequency

```{r, fig.width=10, fig.height=3.5}
PlotBoxplotsProp(
  seuobj@meta.data %>% droplevels,
  ann.col = "cellstate",
  filterCol = "cellstate",
  filterVal = c("Th1", "Th17", "PD1Hi Tfh", "IgG1 PC"),
  relative.to = "celltype",
  minDenomFreq = 10,
  fillVar = "timepoint",
  exportDF = T
) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = diagSub, y = prop)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, fill = NA) +
  geom_point(aes(fill = diagSub, shape = timepoint), size = 5,
             alpha = 0.75, position = position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 0.75, seed = thisseed)) +
  facet_grid(~cellstate) +
  scale_size_continuous(range = c(2, 7)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = diagSubColVec) +
  scale_color_manual(values = diagSubColVec) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = timepointShapeVec) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = percent) +
  guides(fill = "none") +
  labs(
    x = NULL, 
    y = "Percentage of Cell Type", 
    shape = NULL,
    subtitle = NULL) +
  theme_light() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold", angle = 0, hjust=0.5),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
    axis.title.x = element_blank(),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.text = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold", color = "black"),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = "black", linewidth = 1),
  )
```
```{r}
PlotBoxplotsProp(
  seuobj@meta.data %>% droplevels,
  ann.col = "cellstate",
  filterCol = "cellstate",
  filterVal = c("Th1", "Th17", "PD1Hi Tfh", "IgG1 PC"),
  relative.to = "celltype",
  minDenomFreq = 10,
  exportDF = T
) %>% 
  pivot_wider(id_cols = biopsy, names_from = cellstate, values_from = prop) -> props.cellstates

props.cellstates
```

## mTiRP

```{r}
PlotBoxplotsFeatures(
  seuobj@meta.data %>% filter(!is.na(cdr3.TRB)),
  seurat = "seuobj",
  features = c("mTiRP"),
  relative.to = "cellsubtype",
  filterCol = "cellsubtype",
  filterVal = c("Tfh"),
  minDenomFreq = 50,
  plotTitle = NULL,
  exportSampleDF = T
)  %>% 
  group_by(diagSub, cellsubtype, featureVar, .drop = FALSE) %>% 
  mutate(mean = mean(meanVal, na.rm = T)) %>% 
  mutate(se = sd(meanVal, na.rm = T)/sqrt(n())) %>%
  ungroup() %>% 
  ggplot(.,
         aes(x = diagSub, y = meanVal, fill = diagSub)) + 
  geom_bar(stat = "summary", fun = "mean", color = "black", fill = "gray90") +
  geom_point(aes(shape = timepoint), position = position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 1.25, seed = thisseed), size = 4, color = "black") +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean - se, ymax = mean + se), width=0.3, linewidth=1) +
  facet_wrap(~featureVar, scales = "fixed", ncol = 10) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = diagSubColVec) +
  scale_color_manual(values = diagSubColVec) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = timepointShapeVec) +
  guides(fill = "none") +
  labs(
    y = "Mean mTiRP",
    color = NULL,
    fill = NULL,
    title = NULL,
    shape = NULL,
    subtitle = NULL) +
  theme_light() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 24, face = "bold"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold"),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 20, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 20, face = "bold"),
    axis.title.x = element_blank(),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 20, face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "none",
    legend.text = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 20, face = "bold", color = "black"),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = "black", linewidth = 1),
  )
```

```{r}
PlotBoxplotsFeatures(
  seuobj@meta.data %>% filter(!is.na(cdr3.TRB)),

  relative.to = "cellsubtype",

  filterVal = c("Tfh"),
  minDenomFreq = 50,
  plotTitle = NULL,
  exportSampleDF = T
)  %>%

  mutate(mean = mean(meanVal, na.rm = T)) %>% 
  mutate(se = sd(meanVal, na.rm = T)/sqrt(n())) %>%
  ungroup() %>% 
  pivot_wider(id_cols = biopsy, names_from = featureVar, values_from = meanVal) -> mtirp.df

mtirp.df
```

## TNF Scoring

```{r, fig.width=5, fig.height=5}
PlotBoxplotsFeatures(
  seuobj@meta.data %>% 
    mutate("dummy" = factor("dummy")) %>%

    droplevels,
  seurat = "seuobj",

  relative.to = "dummy",

  minDenomFreq = 10,
  plotTitle = NULL,
  exportSampleDF = T

  ggplot(.,
         aes(x = diagSub, y = meanVal, fill = diagSub)) + 
  geom_bar(stat = "summary", fun = "mean", color = "black", fill = "gray90") +
  geom_point(aes(shape = timepoint, color = antitnf_response), position = position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 1.25, seed = thisseed), size = 4, stroke = 1) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean - se, ymax = mean + se), width=0.3, linewidth=1) +
  facet_wrap(~featureVar, scales = "fixed", ncol = 10) +

  scale_color_manual(values = atnfColVec) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = timepointShapeVec) +
  guides(fill = "none") +
  labs(
    y = "Mean Pathway Score\n(Myeloid+TNKILC)",
    color = NULL,
    fill = NULL,
    title = NULL,
    shape = NULL,
    subtitle = NULL) +
  theme_light() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 24, face = "bold"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold"),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 20, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 20, face = "bold"),
    axis.title.x = element_blank(),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 20, face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.text = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
    legend.box = "vertical",
    strip.text = element_text(size = 20, face = "bold", color = "black"),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = "black", linewidth = 1),
  )
```

## Geometric Mean

```{r}
CellFreqDF <- PlotBoxplotsProp(df = seuobj@meta.data %>% 
                                 # filter(timepoint == "T0") %>%
                                 # filter(str_detect(cellstate, "Prlf.", negate = T)) %>% 
                                 # add_count(biopsy, name = "biopsy_count") %>% filter(biopsy_count >= 500) %>% 
                                 add_count(cellstate, name = "cellstate_count") %>% filter(cellstate_count >= 100) %>%
                                 droplevels,
                 ann.col = "cellstate", 
                 relative.to = "celltype", 
                 exportDF = T
                ) %>% 
  complete(biopsy, cellstate, fill = list(annotation.freq = 0, denominator.freq = 0, prop = 0), explicit = TRUE) %>% 
  group_by(biopsy) %>% 
  fill(diagSub) %>% 
  group_by(cellstate) %>% 
  fill(celltype) %>% 
  ungroup

CellFreqDF
```


```{r}
CellFreqDF.wide <- CellFreqDF %>% 
  pivot_wider(id_cols = c(biopsy, diagSub), names_from = cellstate, values_from = prop)

CellFreqDF.wide
```


```{r}
corr.list <- list(
  "Th1" = c("TFPI2Hi Fibro.", "Inflm. Mac", "Th1", "Treg", "XCL+ NK"),
  "Th17" = c("Inflm. Mac","CCL24+ Gob.", "LGR5+ Epi.", "SAA+ Epi.", "Venule", "PDPNHi Fibro.", "Inflm. Mac", "MNP", "Th17", "Prlf. Teff"),
  "PD1Hi Tfh" = c("SAA+ Epi.", "PDPNHi Fibro.", "IgG1 PC", "GC-like BC", "Plasmablast", "Prlf. BC", "PD1Hi Tfh")
)
corr.list
```


```{r}
CellFreqDF.wide.scored <- CellFreqDF.wide %>% 
  rowwise %>%
  mutate(geommean.th1 = pick(all_of(corr.list$Th1)) %>% as.matrix %>% logInf %>% rowMeans(., na.rm = T) %>% exp, .before = biopsy) %>% 
  mutate(geommean.th17 = pick(all_of(corr.list$Th17)) %>% as.matrix %>% logInf %>% rowMeans(., na.rm = T) %>% exp, .before = biopsy) %>% 
  mutate(geommean.tfh = pick(all_of(corr.list$`PD1Hi Tfh`)) %>% as.matrix %>% logInf %>% rowMeans(., na.rm = T) %>% exp, .before = biopsy) %>% 
  ungroup %>% 
  right_join(seuobj@meta.data %>% select(biopsy, antitnf_response, severity_score, severity_score_range, participant_id, timepoint) %>% distinct(biopsy, .keep_all = T), ., by = "biopsy")


CellFreqDF.wide.scored
```

```{r, fig.width=6, fig.height=4}
ggplot(CellFreqDF.wide.scored %>% mutate(dummy = "dummy"), aes(x = diagSub, y = geommean.th1, fill = diagSub)) + 
  geom_point(size = 4, aes(shape = timepoint), alpha = 0.75, 
             position = position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 0.75, seed = thisseed)) +
  stat_summary(fun.data = "mean_cl_boot", geom = "errorbar", width = 0.6, color = "black") +
  stat_summary(fun = "mean", geom = "crossbar", width = 0.6, linewidth = 0.6, 
               aes(color = diagSub)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = diagSubColVec) + 
  scale_color_manual(values = diagSubColVec) + 
  scale_shape_manual(values = timepointShapeVec) +
  facet_wrap(~dummy, labeller = as_labeller(c("dummy" ="Th1-Associated Geometric Mean"))) +
  labs(
    y = "Geometric Mean of Th1\nAssociated Cellstate Frequency",
    shape = NULL
  ) +
  theme_light() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 20, face = "bold"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 24, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
    axis.title.x = element_blank(),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "none",
    legend.text = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 16, color = "black", face = "bold"),
    strip.background = element_rect(color = "black", fill = "white")
  )
```

## Canonical Cytokines

```{r, fig.width=8, fig.height=4}
PlotBoxplotsFeatures(

  features = c("IFNG","TNF","IL17A"),

  filterCol = "cellsubtype",

  mutate(mean = mean(meanVal, na.rm = T)) %>% 
  mutate(se = sd(meanVal, na.rm = T)/sqrt(n())) %>%
  ungroup() %>% 
  ggplot(.,
         aes(x = diagSub, y = meanVal, fill = diagSub)) + 
  geom_bar(stat = "summary", fun = "mean", color = "black", fill = "gray90") +
  geom_point(aes(shape = timepoint), position = position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 1.25, seed = thisseed), size = 4, color = "black") +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean - se, ymax = mean + se), width=0.3, linewidth=1) +
  facet_wrap(~featureVar, scales = "fixed", ncol = 10) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = diagSubColVec) +
  scale_color_manual(values = diagSubColVec) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = timepointShapeVec) +
```

# Combine into DataFrame

```{r}
biopsies.df <- seuobj@meta.data %>% 
  distinct(biopsy, diagSub, participant_id, timepoint, antitnf_response) %>% arrange(biopsy) %>% 
  mutate(huprot = ifelse(participant_id %in% c("001-036", "001-038"), "ENO1+", "ENO1-")) %>% 
  mutate(huprot = fct_relevel(huprot, c("ENO1+", "ENO1-"))) %>% 
  filter(participant_id %notin% c("003-030", "003-034", "003-036", "003-051")) # remove participants w/o HuProt data
  
biopsies.df
```


```{r}
combined.df <- biopsies.df %>% 
  inner_join(.,props.cellstates,by = "biopsy") %>% 
  inner_join(.,geommean.df,by = "biopsy") %>% 
  inner_join(.,features.thelper,by = "biopsy") %>% 
  inner_join(.,features.tfh,by = "biopsy") %>% 
  inner_join(.,features.stat1,by = "biopsy") %>% 
  inner_join(.,tnf.out,by = "biopsy") %>% 
  inner_join(.,il17.out,by = "biopsy") %>% 
  inner_join(.,mtirp.df,by = "biopsy")

combined.df
```

```{r}
write_csv(combined.df, "out/summary/251017__tcellfeatures.csv")
saveRDS(combined.df, "out/summary/251017__tcellfeatures.rds")
```
